answer.label: Reported of Diogenes in the Alexander anecdote
answer.sourceLine: Wikiquote gives this sunshine version of the reply to Alexander. The accessible Laërtius text instead says “Stand out of my light.” The anecdote is traceable, but this English translation is not pinned.
